notes:
{得失|とくしつ} combines ⟦{得|とく}→得：12563_toku⟧ (gain) and {失|しつ} (loss) to mean advantages and disadvantages, or pros and cons.

FORMS:
⟦{得|とく}→得：12563_toku⟧ (gain, benefit) + {失|しつ} (loss) = gains and losses

SENSE 1 - PROS AND CONS:
- {得失|とくしつ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{考|かんが}える→考える：00856_kangaeru⟧: to consider the pros and cons
- {得失|とくしつ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{比較|ひかく}→比較：03576_hikaku⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to compare advantages and disadvantages
- {得失|とくしつ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{度外視|どがいし}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to disregard gains and losses

SENSE 2 - SPORTS (GOAL DIFFERENCE):
- {得失点|とくしってん}⟦{差|さ}→差：02771_sa⟧: goal difference (goals scored minus goals conceded)
- {得失点|とくしってん}: points scored/conceded

This is used in soccer, basketball, and other sports to break ties in standings.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{利害|りがい}→利害：04091_rigai⟧: interests, advantages and disadvantages (often about conflicting interests)
- ⟦メリット→メリット：06848_meritto⟧・⟦デメリット→デメリット：06849_demeritto⟧: merits and demerits (loanwords, very common)
- ⟦{長所|ちょうしょ}→長所：03121_chousho⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{短所|たんしょ}→短所：04506_tansho⟧: strengths and weaknesses
- ⟦{一長一短|いっちょういったん}→一長一短：04774_icchouittan⟧: having both merits and demerits

REGISTER:
{得失|とくしつ} is formal and often appears in written or business contexts.
